summary: testing_run_test.sh against private copies of tools/dev/testing.sh, each fault failing its rows

faults.name: paste
faults.summary: the command pasted into the single-quoted argument, which fails the rows with quotes and the long one, and not the one without quotes

edits.find: ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$HOST" "MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe -e bash -lc 'cd $DEST && export RACH2_QEMU_ACCEL=tcg RACH2_MIN_FREE_GIB=40 && read -r c && bash <(base64 -d <<< \$c)'" \
edits.replace: ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$HOST" "MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe -e bash -lc 'cd $DEST && export RACH2_QEMU_ACCEL=tcg RACH2_MIN_FREE_GIB=40 && $*'" \

faults.name: quoted
faults.summary: the command decoded inside double quotes, which cmd.exe on the host misreads

edits.find: ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$HOST" "MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe -e bash -lc 'cd $DEST && export RACH2_QEMU_ACCEL=tcg RACH2_MIN_FREE_GIB=40 && read -r c && bash <(base64 -d <<< \$c)'" \
edits.replace: ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$HOST" "MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe -e bash -lc 'cd $DEST && export RACH2_QEMU_ACCEL=tcg RACH2_MIN_FREE_GIB=40 && read -r c && eval \"\$(printf %s \"\$c\" | base64 -d)\"'" \

faults.name: gitfile
faults.summary: a worktree's `.git` file sent as it is

faults.name: missing
faults.summary: the wait probe ended by `cat` of a result file the run has not written yet, which fails, so that the probe's output is lost

faults.name: unanswered
faults.summary: a probe the host did not answer taken for a run that ended
